sources.title: GitHub - raneshrk02/RAG_Summarizer: RAG Model
sources.snippet: A complete Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system with LLM integration and comprehensive monitoring for meeting data, designed for an AI-insurance entrepreneur. The system processes meeting transcripts, extracts insights, and provides intelligent AI-generated answers with sub-30-second response times using Mistral AI.

sources.title: RAG-Based Document Summarizer - GitHub
sources.snippet: 📄 RAG-Based Document Summarizer A web app for automatic summarization of long documents using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). The system processes PDF, TXT, and Markdown files, retrieves semantically relevant content, and generates concise summaries using transformer-based models.

sources.title: How I Used RAG to Summarize 1000 PDFs with OpenAI + FAISS
sources.snippet: Built a RAG-based summarization engine using OpenAI + FAISS to summarize 1,000 PDFs efficiently. Learn how retrieval + LLMs changed my workflow.

sources.title: RAG-Based Document Summarizer using LLMs and FAISS
sources.snippet: Our RAG summarizer combines semantic retrieval and LLM‑based summarization to produce query‑driven, factual, and relevant document summaries. The open‑source, user‑friendly design makes it accessible to technical and non‑technical audiences alike.

sources.title: Enhance AI responses by using Retrieval Augmented Generation
sources.snippet: RAG is a design pattern that improves AI accuracy by combining two capabilities: Information retrieval: Searching enterprise data sources. Text generation: Synthesizing the retrieved information by using a language model. This approach reduces incorrect information, increases trust, and generates responses rooted in real organizational content.
